title: Continuous keyboard input reaches the requested renewal target
expected: the recorded successful renewal count is at least 1 before the 15-second interval ends
a protected validation request with the installed access credential returns result true

assertions.name: successful renewal count at least one in fifteen seconds

limits: Actual Chromium portal, React hooks, reducers, Axios interceptors and services.
Controlled browser time, synthetic identity and auth responses. Protected peer assertions are fixture-level, not production RSA authorization.
Native device, VPN, real sleep, independent devices and unavailable target boundaries remain blocked.
